title: Sherpa Stretch™ Blanket
description:
Our best-selling blanket, now lined with uniquely stretchy, irresistibly soft sherpa for serious warmth. The extra-thick 10' x 10' Sherpa Stretch™ Blanket is the biggest sherpa throw you can buy—ultimate coziness on the coldest nights.

  • 10' x 10' (100 square feet) & ~12 lbs
  • Uniquely stretchy, ultra-plush sherpa lining
  • Biggest sherpa blanket you can buy
  • Wrinkle resistant, ultra-durable stitching

A warm, welcome holiday or housewarming gift. 100-night guarantee.
